protocol.code: 9391103 added the event index and hearing tools. Later additions include the depth reader and durable reader journals.
protocol.model: Local Codex gpt-6.1-terra, ephemeral sessions, low reasoning effort, no shell or project access during blind answers. The image/text client sees acoustic evidence from waveform readers and spectra.
protocol.sounds: FSD50K holdout mixtures. Each half-second reference is taken at its loudest region and inserted with opposite polarity at a hash-selected offset into the other recorded sound. 50 ms tolerance. Strong normalized correlation cutoff 0.70. Negative control is the same bed on its own.
protocol.layers: All 43 of 48 holdout second sources for which the local pool had the same label from another uploader. Choose that example by SHA-256 of source/reference IDs, select its highest-RMS two seconds, release it before the original four-second mixture. The model does not see labels. Run listen_layer selection through LayerReader.inspect. Compare selected estimate or untouched mixture with the actual second isolated source by SI-SDR.
protocol.voices: 14 LibriSpeech test-clean speakers, two consecutive utterances per speaker, from row offsets 0..2340 in steps of 180. First pass enrolls all 14, second pass uses a different utterance. No cross-utterance samples in the encoder window. Majority assigned track per utterance, ties resolved by first occurrence.
protocol.pictures: 18 available point-annotated videos. Choose one eligible 30-frame sequence per video by a fixed hash. Match initial automatic landmark to each annotated point within .08 in normalized image coordinates. Count a miss if the initially matched track is lost.
protocol.depth: DA-2K dataset 528f83c26f02a6a7a11c5a036dfc9ee19907ebd9. Eight images per scenario selected by SHA-256. Measure all annotated points from image pixels, randomize point order deterministically. Count an unresolved decision as a miss.
protocol.field: Same 51 non-overlapping four-second first-channel TUT Sound Events 2016 excerpts as acoustic-layers.json. Use contrast_interval on the released four seconds, adding .18s earlier and .32s later but staying in the clip. With no contrast span use the entire clip. Estimate the background from up to 1.5s of the same recording immediately before that target, including earlier context if available. Human labels were withheld. AF-Next read the estimated waveform. GPT saw the whole-mix reading and spectrum, estimate reading and spectrum with the previous two-source naming prompt. Names were graded using the earlier blind semantic reconciliation rubric. Count at most one success per clip. Short annotations do not exhaust all audible background.
protocol.humans: Same 16 Clotho recordings, five human free descriptions and four AQA questions with three votes per question as the previous replication panel. New GPT description sees the earlier open waveform readings, original spectrum and current playback landmarks. Questions additionally include the existing local question-conditioned reading of those same samples. The control repeats the same GPT probability prompt and images, omitting only landmarks. Each arm ran once. Human descriptions are verified by hash. The interval bootstraps films. All Brier losses use individual votes.
protocol.door: Local signed-in Codex, waveform-only AF-Next reading, spectrum and published anonymous attack cues. A, B and silence were answered independently. A and C evidence hashes matched and the answer was reused for C.
protocol.av_binding: All 48 held-out clips from the archived Perception Test source-visibility panel. Five seconds through the annotated exposure. Motion/level alignment competes with other grid regions and shifted controls. Score a visible source only if a proposed region centre lies inside a human box. Counterfactual condition circularly shifts the released clip audio by 480 ms. A region in a hidden-source clip can coincide with unrelated activity.
protocol.binding_listeners: Same 48 dated human annotations. Run the production playback to the cutoff, refer to its last tenth of a second by event ID, then inspect binding. A fresh GPT sees the independent three-second Audio Flamingo impression, spectrum and complete displayed picture. It can indicate one normalized point, unseen or unresolved. In the other arm it sees the same picture with the acoustic evidence of another annotated class. The target annotation and source options are withheld. Score only points inside a human box. On hidden sources, report visible guesses as well as explicit unseen and unresolved.
protocol.runtime: Three runs per version on this Mac. Same first eight seconds of the 70s demo, original two-second continuous turns, movie-only playback, no semantic models. Order before/current/current/before/before/current. Wall time after import includes decoding, building the turn and publishing its files. Single-process max RSS is the larger of parent and child rusage values, not aggregate concurrent RSS.
